rolesSection.subtitle: Each role is specialised – together they cover your team's everyday work. Roles without "coming soon" are ready to use today.

roleDesc.reception: Answers calls, filters, forwards or gives information – around the clock, no hold music.
roleDesc.sales: Qualifies leads, answers initial questions and hands hot contacts straight to your team.
roleDesc.support: Answers FAQs via web chat – in your brand's tone, in multiple languages.
roleDesc.orders: Takes orders and reservations, checks availability and confirms instantly.
roleDesc.office: Sorts emails, coordinates appointments and syncs calendars – no back-and-forth.
roleDesc.recruiting: Runs initial interviews with applicants, checks availability and books slots in your HR team's calendar.
roleDesc.collection: Sends friendly reminders about open invoices instead of acting like a collection agency.
roleDesc.onboarding: Guides new customers or employees through their first 30 days and answers early questions.
roleDesc.finance: Reads receipts and invoices and hands the data to your accounting.

industriesSection.subtitle: Same platform, tailored to your industry. Industries without "coming soon" are ready to use today.

industryDesc.restaurants: Take table reservations and orders automatically by phone, answer guest questions instantly.
industryDesc.hotels: Room reservations and guest service around the clock – no front desk needed on the night shift.
industryDesc.handwerker: Take appointment requests for repairs and installations automatically instead of missing calls.
industryDesc.arztpraxen: Book appointments for treatments – patients can reach the practice even outside opening hours.
industryDesc.friseure: Let clients book, reschedule, or cancel appointments automatically by phone, even on weekends.
industryDesc.autowerkstaetten: Take workshop appointments and requests directly by phone instead of making customers wait for a callback.
industryDesc.immobilien: Let viewing appointments for your listings be scheduled automatically.

platformSection.desc: Secure, GDPR-compliant and hosted in the EU. Kiwo runs on proven infrastructure — voice AI from Anthropic, telephony via Vapi, automated notifications via n8n.

roi.subtitle: One number is all it takes: how many calls do you miss per week? The rest runs on a realistic default assumption — entirely about phone calls.
roi.assumptionsNote: Also based on typical values for small businesses, entirely about phone calls: 30 regular calls/week (which Kiwo takes on in addition to your missed calls), avg. 4 min. call duration, €21/hr fully-loaded cost.
